messages.text:
Happy to point you at the right one. Two picks lead our lineup: the Harlo B30, 30 TH/s at $899, and the Magic Miner 40T, 40 TH/s at $799, which is the cheapest hashrate we sell. Both are pre-sale, B30 ships October 30 and the Magic Miner November 14.

Before I say which, which state or country are you in? Electricity rate decides it, and I'll run your actual sats-per-month and power cost on it.
